solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/report-spam-message/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

3295. Report Spam Message

You are given an array of strings message and an array of strings bannedWords.

An array of words is considered spam if there are at least two words in it that exactly match any word in bannedWords.

Return true if the array message is spam, and false otherwise.

Example 1:

Input: message = ["hello","world","leetcode"], bannedWords = ["world","hello"]
Output: true
Explanation:
The words "hello" and "world" from the message array both appear in the bannedWords array.

Example 2:

Input: message = ["hello","programming","fun"], bannedWords = ["world","programming","leetcode"]
Output: false
Explanation:
Only one word from the message array ("programming") appears in the bannedWords array.

Constraints:

    1 <= message.length, bannedWords.length <= 10^5
    1 <= message[i].length, bannedWords[i].length <= 15
    message[i] and bannedWords[i] consist only of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def reportSpam(self, message: List[str], bannedWords: List[str]) -> bool:
        banned_set = set(bannedWords)
        count = 0
        for word in message:
            if word in banned_set:
                count += 1
                if count >= 2:
                    return True
        return False


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reportSpam(["hello", "world", "leetcode"], ["world", "hello"]))  # True

assert sol.reportSpam(["hello", "world", "leetcode"], ["world", "hello"]) == True
assert (
    sol.reportSpam(
        ["hello", "programming", "fun"], ["world", "programming", "leetcode"]
    )
    == False
)

assert sol.reportSpam([], []) == False
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam"], ["spam"]) == False
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam", "spam"], ["spam"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["a"] * 100000, ["a"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["a"] * 100000, ["b"]) == False
assert sol.reportSpam(["a", "b", "c", "d"], ["a", "b"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["a", "b", "c", "d"], ["a"]) == False
assert sol.reportSpam(["a", "b", "c", "d"], ["e", "f"]) == False
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam", "ham", "spam"], ["spam"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam", "ham", "eggs"], ["spam", "ham"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam", "ham", "eggs"], ["spam", "eggs"]) == True
assert sol.reportSpam(["spam", "ham", "eggs"], ["spam", "ham", "eggs"]) == True
